RD-003 overnight_drift holds the fixed 21:00->07:00 UTC window outright / fades its previous window on forex+commodities; RD-005 conditions direction on the prior move at three local session opens and at five UTC hour marks, uses pure time exits, and its primary panel is crypto (24/7 session effects), which RD-003's time families do not touch

RD-003 london_drive is an Asia-range breakout at 07:00 UTC with ATR brackets on forex12/comm7; RD-005's London cells use the 08:00 Europe/London local open, prior-move sign only, no range condition, no brackets - no cell duplicates london_drive's mechanism
RD-003's forex-native mean-reversion track is indicator MR; RD-005 REV variants reverse only the prior session/window move at fixed clock times (session timing, not MR)
breadth: >= 50% of symbols with >= 1 OOS trade have positive expectancy AND no single symbol contributes > 50% of the panel's total positive profit
declared_at: 2026-11-15 (before any RD-005 backtest cell was executed)
family: session / time-of-day effects (session-open impulse + hour-of-day windows)
fold_positive_strictness: the >= 80% rule is applied literally: STANDARD panels need >= 4/5 folds; LATE panels (4 folds) need 4/4 (3/4 = 75% < 80%). Disclosed, not softened.
forex_prior_window_note: on forex, a prior-move window may span a market closure (e.g. Monday Asia open vs Friday close); this is inherent to session research, is causal, and is disclosed rather than adjusted away

standing_bar.dsr: deflated Sharpe ratio computed and reported for near-bar rows; not a veto (RD-002 reasoning: dispersion input not identified at this N)
standing_bar.mechanical: expectancy > 0 AND profit factor >= 1.2 AND >= 200 pooled OOS trades AND >= 80% of folds (with >= 1 OOS trade) positive AND untouched-holdout pass AND breadth pass
standing_bar.sensitivity: any config passing the mechanical bar is re-run at 2x costs and must keep expectancy > 0 and PF >= 1.2 to be a candidate
standing_bar.significance: one-sided t-test on pooled OOS per-trade net returns, Bonferroni p < 0.05 / N_global

subfamily_A_session_open_impulse.mechanism: At each anchor, prior move = close[last bar ending at/before anchor] / close[bar L hours earlier] - 1, using only bars strictly before the entry bar. MOM takes sign(prior move), REV takes the opposite. Prior move == 0: no trade. Entry at the open of the first bar at/after the anchor instant (on 1h panels the NY anchor therefore fills at the 10:00 ET bar open - data-granularity lag, disclosed). Exit at the open of the first bar at/after entry_time + H (clock-based); if none within H+96h, exit at the last bar close (END_OF_DATA). One open position per symbol; entries while busy are skipped.

subfamily_B_hour_window.mechanism: Entries at fixed UTC hours h in {0, 8, 13, 16, 21} (Asia open, London open, NY open, London close, NY close in UTC terms). Direction from the move over the immediately preceding W hours (closes strictly before the entry bar): MOM follows, REV fades. Hold = W (clock-based exit, same rules as A). One open position per symbol.

uncovered: forex 15m: Yahoo 15m depth (~60 days) cannot support walk-forward folds - UNCOVERED, never synthetic
forex session anchors on non-trading days produce no entry (no bar on that local date)
wf_select_procedures: One per sub-family x panel (6): per fold, among that sub-family's variants on that panel, pick the variant with the highest in-sample expectancy (all trades entered before the fold start; minimum 50 in-sample trades, else the fold contributes no trades); that variant's fold trades are the procedure's OOS trades. Judged by the same bar.
